description: Trail line from /api/v1/trails/{slug}/geojson. A schematic line has schematic: true and is not a GPS track. Figures are sourced and dated. They may be provisional. Cite the trail URL and the verifiedDate. Permit status is verified-official, reported-secondary, or unverified, or null when the feed has none. Null means not recorded. This server does not invent figures. A returned figure can be verified with get_provenance and the record signature.
name: get_geojson
title: Get GeoJSON
